{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_count = refunded_mask.sum()

# Define valid completed orders: status == 'completed', not refunded, not QA
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
valid_mask = completed_mask & ~refunded_mask & ~qa_mask

# Filter data
df_filtered = df[valid_mask]

# Compute average revenue per valid completed order
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()
total_orders = len(df_filtered)
avg_revenue = total_revenue / total_orders

print(f'QA orders: {qa_count}')
print(f'Refunded orders: {refunded_count}')
print(f'Valid completed orders: {total_orders}')
print(f'Average revenue per valid order: ${avg_revenue:,.2f}')

# Verify no QA or refunded orders remain
assert len(df_filtered[df_filtered['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]) == 0, "QA orders not filtered"
assert len(df_filtered[df_filtered['status'] == 'refunded']) == 0, "Refunded orders not filtered"

# Final check: ensure revenue_clean is numeric
assert df_filtered['revenue_clean'].dtype == 'float64', "Revenue not properly converted"

# Output the result
df_filtered[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean', 'status', 'converted']].head()"}
